'''''Death by Lightning''''' is an American [[historical drama]] miniseries created by [[Mike Makowsky]] and based on the 2011 book ''[[Destiny of the Republic]]'' by [[Candice Millard]]. It stars [[Michael Shannon]] as [[President of the United States|United States President]] [[James A. Garfield]] and [[Matthew Macfadyen]] as his assassin [[Charles J. Guiteau]]. The four-episode series premiered on November 6, 2025, on [[Netflix]]. It received widespread acclaim from critics, with particular praise for the performances, and was named one of the [[American Film Institute Awards#2025|best television programs of the year]] by the [[American Film Institute]].

==Premise==
The series depicts the election and presidency of [[James A. Garfield]], the 20th [[President of the United States|United States President]], including his anti-corruption and pro-[[Civil and political rights|civil rights]] stances, as well as how his path crossed with [[Charles J. Guiteau]], a deluded admirer, who ended up [[Assassination of James A. Garfield|shooting him]], leading to Garfield's death.

==Production==
===Development===
The series was announced in February 2024, with [[Michael Shannon]] cast to play Garfield, and [[Matthew Macfadyen]] to play Guiteau.<ref name="SeriesOrder">{{cite web |last=White |first=Peter |date=February 1, 2024 |title=Michael Shannon & Matthew Macfadyen to Star in President Garfield Assassination Series ''Death by Lightning'' for Netflix |url=https://deadline.com/2024/02/michael-shannon-matthew-macfadyen-death-by-lightning-netflix-1235810651/ |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=November 8, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Soloski |first=Alexis |date=November 6, 2025 |title=In ''Death by Lightning'' Matthew Macfadyen and Michael Shannon Make Sparks Fly |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/11/05/arts/television/death-by-lightning-matthew-macfadyen-michael-shannon.html |newspaper=[[The New York Times]] |access-date=November 8, 2025}}</ref> Shannon was keen to play Garfield as he himself did not know anything about the man.<ref>{{cite web |last=Brunner |first=Raven |date=November 5, 2025 |title=Michael Shannon Admits He 'Didn't Know Much' Before Playing President James Garfield in ''Death by Lightning'' |url=https://uk.news.yahoo.com/michael-shannon-admits-didnt-know-190000777.html |publisher=[[Yahoo! News]] |access-date=November 8, 2025}}</ref> Macfadyen compared his interpretation of Guiteau to the Pixar villain [[List of The Incredibles characters#Syndrome|Syndrome]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Dodge |first1=Jeff |last2=Crowley |first2=Liam |date=November 4, 2025 |title=Netflix's New Political Assassination Thriller Has an Unexpected Pixar Connection |url=https://screenrant.com/death-by-lightning-netflix-pixar-connection-syndrome-mathew-macfadyen/ |website=[[Screen Rant]] |access-date=November 8, 2025}}</ref> [[Matt Ross (actor)|Matt Ross]] was set to direct all episodes of the series.<ref name="SeriesOrder"/> Later that month, [[Nick Offerman]] and [[Betty Gilpin]] joined the cast, as [[Chester A. Arthur]] and [[Lucretia Garfield]], respectively.<ref>{{cite web |last=Otterson |first=Joe |title=Nick Offerman, Betty Gilpin Join Netflix's President Garfield Assassination Series ''Death by Lightning'' |url=https://variety.com/2024/tv/news/nick-offerman-betty-gilpin-netflix-president-garfield-assassination-series-death-by-lightning-1235925784/ |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |access-date=February 28, 2024 |date=February 28, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=O'Keefe |first=Meghan |date=November 7, 2025 |title=''Death by Lightning'' Gives Nick Offerman the Role of a Lifetime in Chester A. Arthur: 'Those Were His Actual Muttonchops' |url=https://decider.com/2025/11/07/death-by-lightning-nick-offerman-chester-a-arthur-muttonchops/ |website=[[New York Post#Decider|Decider]] |access-date=November 8, 2025}}</ref> In May, [[Bradley Whitford]] and [[Shea Whigham]] were added, with [[Stephen McKinley Henderson]], [[Paula Malcomson]] and [[Tuppence Middleton]] joining in recurring roles.<ref>{{cite web |last=Andreeva |first=Nellie |title=Bradley Whitford & Shea Whigham Join Netflix's ''Death by Lightning'', 3 Others Cast |url=https://deadline.com/2024/05/bradley-whitford-shea-whigham-death-by-lightning-netflix-cast-1235938034/ |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=May 24, 2024 |date=May 24, 2024}}</ref> [[Laura Marcus (actress)|Laura Marcus]] was added in July.<ref>{{cite web |last=Goldbart |first=Max |title=Netflix Finds Its President Garfield's Daughter for ''Death by Lightning'' Series Starring Michael Shannon as 20th POTUS |url=https://deadline.com/2024/07/death-by-lightning-netflix-laura-marcus-1236014092/ |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=October 2, 2024 |date=July 19, 2024}}</ref> In October, additional castings were announced, including [[Barry Shabaka Henley]] (replacing McKinley Henderson in his role), [[Vondie Curtis-Hall]] and [[Željko Ivanek]].<ref name="Curtis-Hall and Ivanek">{{cite web |last=Campione |first=Katie |title=''Death by Lightning'': Vondie Curtis Hall, Željko Ivanek & Barry Shabaka Henley Among 8 to Join Netflix Limited Series |url=https://deadline.com/2024/10/death-by-lightning-cast-netflix-vondie-curtis-hall-zeljko-ivanek-barry-shabaka-henley-1236113706/ |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=October 11, 2024 |date=October 11, 2024}}</ref>

Filming began in [[Budapest]] on July 1, 2024,<ref>{{cite web |title=''Death by Lightning'' – Budapest Sets Stage for Netflix's Presidential Drama |url=https://www.budapestreporter.com/death-by-lightning-budapest-sets-stage-for-netflixs-presidential-drama/ |website=Budapest Reporter |access-date=April 21, 2024 |date=April 4, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://productionlist.com/production/death-by-lightning/ |title=''Death by Lightning'' |website=Film & Television Industry Alliance |access-date=October 14, 2024}}</ref> and wrapped in October of the same year.<ref name="Curtis-Hall and Ivanek"/>

==Release==
''Death by Lightning'' premiered on November 6, 2025, on [[Netflix]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2025/08/death-by-lightning-michael-shannon-netflix-release-date-1236493700/ |title=''Death By Lightning'' Starring Michael Shannon & Matthew Macfadyen Gets Netflix Premiere Date |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |first=Denise |last=Petski |date=August 21, 2025 |access-date=August 21, 2025}}</ref>

==Reception==
===Critical response===
On the [[review aggregator]] website [[Rotten Tomatoes]], 90% of 69 critics' reviews are positive. The website's critics consensus reads: "Handsomely mounted and electrified by Matthew Macfadyen's masterclass in slimy desperation, ''Death by Lightning'' concisely dramatizes a fork in history while wistfully hinting at what could've been."<ref>{{cite Rotten Tomatoes|id=death_by_lightning|type=tv|season=1|access-date=April 30, 2026|publisher_hide=y}}{{cbignore}}</ref> On [[Metacritic]], the series has a weighted average score of 80 out of 100, based on 31 critics, indicating "universal acclaim".<ref>{{cite Metacritic|id=death-by-lightning|type=tv|season=1|access-date=April 30, 2026|publisher_hide=y}}{{cbignore}}</ref>

extract: Death by Lightning is an American historical drama miniseries created by Mike Makowsky and based on the 2011 book Destiny of the Republic by Candice Millard. It stars Michael Shannon as United States President James A. Garfield and Matthew Macfadyen as his assassin Charles J. Guiteau. The four-episode series premiered on November 6, 2025, on Netflix. It received widespread acclaim from critics, with particular praise for the performances, and was named one of the best television programs of the year by the American Film Institute.
